target.rule_check: Target rule: the newest stable tag with no open Claude OAuth or Codex regression reachable in the rendered configuration; there is no minimum upstream age. Frozen on 2026-10-27 at 11:53:07Z against a fresh public clone and the GitHub releases API, and re-checked at 12:57Z: v8.0.44 (1f917e77, published 2026-10-26T15:49:33Z) and v8.0.43 (30780351, 2026-10-25T15:37:22Z) are the stable tags after the 8.0.42 pin, neither a prerelease or a draft, and nothing newer exists; the tag ref and ls-remote agree on 1f917e77. (1) Every commit since the pin is classified below (33 non-merge commits, 35 with the merges cf4fc4e7 and ec81e70a), with tools/upstream_delta.py --series admitted --mode both. (2) The issues and pull requests opened since 2026-10-26T10:00Z (50 items) and the older open Claude, Codex, cooling and discovery items were read: none is an open Claude OAuth or Codex regression reachable in the rendered configuration. #6948 (re-login after a failed refresh, local admission 33) is fixed upstream by 21553509 and closed as completed. #7017 (Codex capacity 429 with a multi-minute Retry-After) is reachable but no regression: under request-retry 0 and disable-cooling true each client request reaches the upstream once and the client receives the 429 without the Retry-After header, on the ChatGPT account and OpenAI key routes (test_gateway_v8_traffic CodexCapacityRejectionTests); it stays a known limit. #7035 (gpt-5.5 listed but refused on a ChatGPT account) concerns a line charmer retired (gpt55 in retired.json). (3) Go stays 1.27.3, the newest stable release at the freeze; golang.org/x/net has no tag after v0.61.0 and CVE-2026-97045 is unpublished (OSV 404, GitHub advisory database empty, vuln.go.dev modified 2026-10-21).

admission: The 8.0.44 re-pin review (2026-10-27) covered 2 releases and 33 non-merge commits (35 with merges) from 8.0.42 through the frozen tag. tools/upstream_delta.py measured 17 exact-context rejects in patches 3, 9, 20, 27 and 33 plus one in the module patch, and 88 line offsets in 16 patches; the port rebased the byte-identical 8.0.42 series onto the tag and every patch now applies with no reject, offset or fuzz. Classification: 19 have no effect in the rendered configuration; 7 change reachable behaviour that the re-pin carries without touching what a patch protects; 5 change a reachable surface that is now proven by a row (3e7a21e2 per-turn WebSocket re-authentication, e48d780f caller-scoped MCP aliases, 531721bf commentary replay, 058b803b CORS, and 064e008b, whose Codex compression and decoder refactor rewrites the request paths patches 3, 9, 20 and 27 protect and adds defaults that act when unset); 1 retires a patch (21553509 retires cli-proxy-api-relogin-after-refresh-failure.patch, admission 33); 1 adds a surface to refuse (27f3abfb, POST /v8/management/oauth/auth-url, now in patch 4's route table). Ids outside the series are never reused (11 was never admitted, 30 was withdrawn, 14, 24, 25 and now 33 retired). The series is 27 patches: admissions 1-10, 12, 13, 15-23, 26-29, 31 and 32, the last a local fix with no upstream commit (cli-proxy-api-terminal-rejection-reload.patch). Patches 16 (oauth-model-overlay) and 17 (no-antigravity-egress) are unchanged in effect: 16 moved by line offsets only and 17 is byte-identical, and their gates and rows are green. Earlier fix dispositions remain below as review history. A fix is backported, as an admitted patch with its own failing-without-the-fix tests and a gate record, only when it is reachable in the configuration charmer renders and it protects stored credentials or the availability of sign-in or API-key routes. Everything else is carried by the re-pin or needs no action.
rendered_configuration: listener on 127.0.0.1 only, every client authenticated by the gateway API key

plugins.enabled false, Home off, discovery off (the gateway schema pins discovery.enabled to false; the running gateway logs no discovery line and holds no UDP socket in its namespace, while an enabled control logs the advertiser: test_gateway_v8_traffic DiscoveryOffTests), pprof off

logging-to-file false, no request-log key and commercial-mode true: the request-logging middleware is never built (internal/api/server.go:186-197 in the patched 8.0.44 tree), so no request or forced error-log file is written and the request-log filename fix (179d43dc) is not reachable
disable-cooling true for every credential, no request-scoped error rules, no per-credential or per-provider cooling override

management only through the environment key and the read-only allowlist on the Nix channel, otherwise off; patch 4 refuses every other management route, the RESP command surface and the listed media, live, alpha-search, Interactions and OAuth-page prefixes with a bare 404, while the Messages, count_tokens, Chat, Responses, Responses websocket and Gemini inference routes stay reachable to holders of the local API key by design
request-retry 0, max-retry-credentials 1, fill-first routing; one auto-refresh loop per process with 16 workers
debug false; unchanged for 2.3.0
--local-model on every gateway run/login; no models: section (effective models {}), so catalogs stay embedded; 2.3.0 never renders models.catalog or other catalog file/URL overrides
remote-management.disable-control-panel true and disable-auto-update-panel true; github-token omitted (effective empty); 2.3.0 never renders github-token
signin-with-chatgpt-identifier omitted and no SIWC sign-in or --siwc-bind; 2.3.0 keeps SIWC unrendered and never passes --siwc-bind
usage-statistics-enabled false; unchanged for 2.3.0
routing.session-affinity true with session-affinity-ttl 24h; session-affinity-rebind-on absent (effective any); unchanged for 2.3.0
max-request-body-bytes absent (effective 0, unlimited); not adopted in 2.3.0 without a large-context body probe
streaming.send-keepalive-before-ft absent (effective false); refused for 2.3.0, not emitted by the rendered-key allowlist
upstream.claude.tool-search and claude-api-key native-tool-search absent (effective false); not adopted or rendered in 2.3.0

tls-handshake-timeout-seconds 20 makes the configured handshake timeout and retry reachable; the healthy-slow-handshake decision remains pending traffic and HTTP/1.1 proxy validation, and the setting is dropped if that validation rejects healthy slow handshakes
claude-header-defaults overrides and client-request-id absent (effective empty client-request-id means on); no such overrides rendered in 2.3.0

oauth-excluded-models: {pool: ["*"]} for pools moved to a reviewed keyed transport (render.py:1210-1218); charmer writes no per-credential excluded_models but records may contain it; 2.3.0 keeps global exclusions authoritative via the additive P15 hunk, including after reload

claude-api-key sections carry no cloak key: since 8.0.34 an explicit cloak mode never on a key without the CLI profile strips Claude Code's identity (084b9ca7); an absent key keeps the caller's shape (claude_executor_cloaking.go:1681-1747)

response-compression.enabled false, codex.websocket-compression false and codex.upstream-request-compression false, rendered since 2.3.0 (gateway.schema.json pins all three to false): when unset, 8.0.44 compresses downstream responses including SSE and negotiates WebSocket permessage-deflate. As rendered the client gets plain bytes, every held-stream ping arrives when the upstream writes it and no WebSocket extension is negotiated; the unset control answers with zstd and permessage-deflate (test_gateway_v8_traffic RenderedCompressionTrafficTests). Codex requests still advertise Accept-Encoding gzip, deflate, br, zstd and are sent plain; the shared decoder decodes gzip, deflate and zstd upstream responses (br not exercised).

codex response steering not rendered (effective false): the Responses WebSocket duplex turns (6340fe43, 3e7a21e2) stay off. Each ordinary Responses WebSocket turn re-authenticates the upgrade's key against the current keys: after rotation's overlap the retired key is refused with 401 on the socket it opened, with no upstream request (test_gateway_v8_traffic ResponsesWebsocketKeyRetirementTests).
These are current-render assumptions for 2.3.0, not a claim beyond the rendered configuration. Any rendered-configuration change reopens the affected reachability reasons before it is merged.

dependencies.go_mod: The source uses the /v8 module path with go 1.26.10 (upstream 633a294f). Upstream's only module change since 8.0.42 is github.com/miekg/dns v1.1.43 becoming a direct requirement (11e5f67b); the vendor tree is unchanged. The module-requirements patch, regenerated around it, moves the pins to x/net 0.61.0, x/crypto 0.58.0, x/sys 0.49.0, x/text 0.43.0, x/sync 0.24.0, compress 1.20.3 and go-git v6.0.0-beta.1 (with go-billy v6.0.0-beta.1, ProtonMail/go-crypto 1.5.2 and sha1cd 0.7.0), still the newest releases on 2026-10-27 (miekg/dns stays at upstream's v1.1.43; discovery is off), and adds the explicit godebug block. The pinned gateway toolchain is Go 1.27.3. Compiled GODEBUG is tracebacklabels=0,x509sslcertoverrideplatform=1, bound in contract v2.
dependencies.go_sum: The module-requirements patch updates checksums through Go's verified module download and tidy; the verified fresh vendor-tree identity and its module sums are recorded in UPSTREAM.json and licenses/modules.json.

vulncheck.reason: Re-reviewed 2026-10-27 for the 8.0.44 upstream change and the 27-patch series, on all four shipped target builds with govulncheck v1.9.0 built by Go 1.27.3 and the online https://vuln.go.dev database (modified 2026-10-21). Each binary reports one reviewed component-absent exception, GO-2026-5932 (the same 15 traces for the present x/crypto v0.58.0 module), and no unreviewed finding. All four source scans (./..., which includes ./cmd/server) report only its module-level trace, and the vulnerable deprecated openpgp packages are absent from the verified vendor tree. The compress and go-git findings stay fixed by the dependency versions (compress 1.20.3, go-git v6.0.0-beta.1), not waived. CVE-2026-97045 has no advisory anywhere checked and x/net no tag after v0.61.0; CVE-2026-78661 (x/net 4af4fce6, untagged) fixes the HTML parser, whose functions no shipped gateway retains. Exact target hashes, advisory revision and trace bindings are in gateway/vulnerability-dispositions.json.

Still not reachable: every change sits behind cooling being enabled, and the 2.3.0 render keeps disable-cooling true for every credential, with no request-scoped error rule and no cooling override (aa4130e6's new skip-cooldown flag in conductor_cooldown.go is inert for the same reason). Any render change that enables cooling reopens this.

fixes.reason: Not reachable: plugins are disabled, so no plugin stream, callback or instance exists.

fixes.subject: fix(auth): preserve file priority across plugin auth refreshes
fixes.reason: Not reachable: the refresh path it fixes runs only through plugin auth adapters (plugins are disabled); its management hunk is refused by the read-only allowlist.

fixes.subject: fix(api): immediately close connections on stop and guard state access
fixes.reason: The v8.0.33 tag supplies listener locking, immediate connection close and the shutdown context created at exit. Re-checked 2026-10-27 against 8.0.44: the local patch still retains only the refresh-worker join through durable save and receipt, on the epoch-checked job model (line offsets only at 8.0.44); the service-refresh-shutdown gates, with and without the race detector, are green. The tagged shutdown-context hunk is no longer a local change.

fixes.subject: fix(session): avoid rescanning large payloads during session extraction
fixes.reason: CPU hardening for large request bodies; requests come only from local clients holding the gateway API key, and no credential or route state is involved.

fixes.subject: fix(interceptors): avoid cloning request body for read-only interceptors
fixes.reason: Resource change with shared-buffer semantics that overlap the keyed-safety and interceptor patches; it needs an ownership audit, not a security backport.

fixes.subject: fix(auth): preserve attributes and path across plugin refreshes
fixes.reason: The plugin refresh part is not reachable (plugins are disabled). The watcher retry matters only when a credential path is missing for more than the 50 ms replace check; every credential writer here (sign-in and refresh saves) replaces the file by an atomic rename, so the path never disappears.

fixes.subject: fix(auth): unschedule disabled invalid_grant credentials and apply exponential backoff for enabled invalid_grant
fixes.reason: Arrives with v8.0.33; re-checked 2026-10-27 against 8.0.44 (reachability unchanged). The disabled part needs a disabled field or a management write: charmer writes neither, and the v8 default-deny refuses management writes. For an enabled credential it only changes how often an already-failed refresh is retried; since 8.0.43 (21553509) changed credentials also reset the refresh-failure count and the refresh backoff. The statuses 'invalid grant (retrying)' and 'disabled (invalid grant)' (conductor_refresh.go) map to invalid_grant in quota.py (REASON_PREFIXES).

fixes.reason: New plugin scheduler contract; plugins are disabled.

fixes.reason: L1 must-fix for cli-proxy-api-management-readonly-allowlist.patch (P4): extend the engine-level default-deny across /v0/management and /v8/management, both engine-level GET/POST OAuth callback pairs, /v0/resource/plugins/* and /management.html. Keep only the existing exact-GET v0 exceptions (auth-files, auth-files/models and model-definitions/:channel); the v8 latest-version, routing/model-definitions and requests/api-call routes stay refused. Also refuse GET /v1/models/*model, POST /v1/audio/speech and POST /v1/tts by default. v8.0.33 registers 41 v8 management routes: 39 in the group (35 direct registrations plus GET, PUT, PATCH and DELETE /config/*path) and 2 engine-level callbacks. L1/L5 must derive the full registered set from s.engine.Routes(), assert that inventory and test the reviewed route table, canonical spellings and Origin/Host refusals; new routes fail the gate. The delta tool reports 38 static registrations because it counts the Handle loop once, not its four runtime methods; that hint is not the route-table gate.

fixes.subject: feat(interactions): Antigravity session continuation and model detail lookup (GET /v1/models/*model)
fixes.reason: The Antigravity part is not reachable. Upstream adds the API-key route GET /v1/models/*model, answering from the final catalog (sdk/api/handlers/handlers_interceptors.go:694); on 7.3.15 that path returned 404. The L1 default-deny must refuse it, and L1/L5 list the refusal in the reviewed route table. L4 checks whether the pinned Claude Code requests /v1/models/{id}; any such evidence requires a new review before the route can be enabled. The charmer-model-ids patch still governs the allowed GET /v1/models listing, not admission of the new detail route.

fixes.subject: feat(payload): introduce payload finalizer for protobuf and multipart requests
fixes.reason: Arrives with the tag and forces the cache-retention rewrite. Payload rules now run at the final serialization barrier in the Claude executor (ApplyPayloadConfigWithTrackedPaths, claude_executor_execute.go:225-259), after the anchor where the 7.3.15 hunks land. The strip must move after payload rules and before signAnthropicMessagesBody, with a Claude override-reintroduction test. The Devin protobuf and multipart parts are not reachable.

fixes.subject: feat(registry): custom model catalog sources and dynamic reload; Devin catalog off for Home
fixes.reason: With --local-model and no models: section (probe: models {}), the general, Codex and Devin catalogs stay embedded (internal/registry/catalog_sources.go:246-260), so there is no catalog egress. L0 choice: rebase cli-proxy-api-oauth-model-overlay.patch (P15), not replace it with models.catalog. CatalogSources selects a process-wide catalog from a file or URL; it does not provide the closed, per-OAuth-channel additive overlay with no header/transport overrides and whole-load refusal on invalid input. Keep that contract and static-wins precedence, refresh the pinned registry snapshot and prove static/overlay collisions at L4. The service_models.go port must also carry the additive global oauth-excluded-models hunk: a credential's excluded_models must never replace the global exclusion, with an own-red seeded-record test and an L4 GET /v1/models check after reload (see b015f208). models.catalog is never rendered in 2.1.0; the L5 no-egress test asserts embedded catalogs. After the v8.0.33 registry refresh, claude-sonnet-5-5 and gpt-6.1-sol are static: gpt-6.1-sol is then served only to team, plus and pro Codex credentials (the overlay served it to every Codex credential), the sonnet qualification text is updated, and the XC probe needs an overlay-only wire the v8.0.33 registry lacks.

Reachable on every credential save, and protects stored credentials: concurrent edits are merged, not overwritten (#6329). cli-proxy-api-credential-save-report.patch is rewritten on persistLocked/mergeAuthSaveDelta (sdk/cliproxy/auth/conductor_persistence.go), keeping credential_save_v1 byte-identical.

fixes.subject: OAuth excluded-models priority, tolerant load of invalid excluded_models, plugin exclusions

Require an own-red test with a seeded record carrying non-empty excluded_models and an L4 served-models check that GET /v1/models lists none of the excluded pool's models after a reload. 1a28c61e keeps a credential loading when its own field is invalid; that availability change remains, but cannot bypass the global exclusion. Write-side validation is management and default-denied.

fixes.subject: fix(auth): restore re-logged credentials to rotation after refresh failures
fixes.reason: Retires local admission 33 (cli-proxy-api-relogin-after-refresh-failure.patch, #6948, closed as completed): updateInternalLocked now resets the refresh-failure count, the refresh backoff and a failed status when changed credentials arrive. Upstream's guard keeps a live quota deadline (Quota.NextRecoverAt) but, unlike the retired patch, lets an invalid_grant reset clear a live non-quota retry deadline. That state is unreachable as rendered: with disable-cooling true for every credential and request-retry 0 no failure sets NextRetryAfter, and every update ends in clearCooldownStateForAuth, which clears it. The retired tests run on the 27-patch tree pass except that one subtest (invalid grant with a live retry deadline: unavailable=false, next_retry=0), which covers a cooling-enabled state and is dropped. The re-login row RA1 (TestOmissionReloginAfterRefreshFailure, invalid_grant and token-endpoint failure) stays as a regression row with no patch to omit. Id 33 is not reused.

fixes.subject: feat(codex): add full-chain compression for Codex upstream and downstream traffic
fixes.reason: Reachable, and the main port conflict: Codex requests go through doCodexRequest (a plain retry after a compressed 400/415) with header preparation in a prepareHeaders callback, and responses through the shared decoder. Ported: patch 3 strips prompt_cache_retention before the new wire-body serialization (TestCodexExecutorCacheHelperStripsRetentionBeforeCompression); patch 9 refuses redirects on both attempts and on the original HttpRequest path (TestCM053CodexCompressedRetryRedirectRefused); patch 20 drops the plain-key session inside prepareHeaders and keeps decoder and helper failures local (TestCodexKeyDecoderFailureIsLocal, TestCodexKeyCompressedFailureBodyIsLocal); patch 27 moved with the block patch 20 supplies. The defaults that act when unset (response compression on, including SSE; Codex WebSocket compression on) are rendered off since 2.3.0 and upstream request compression stays off; rendered_configuration records the traffic rows. A new xAI WebSocket compression-level log site (no credential) joined patch 28's reviewed inventory.

fixes.subject: fix(codex): restore Codex commentary history via internal thinking signature marker
fixes.reason: Closes the 2.2.x known limit POST-GW-6966-COMMENTARY-REPLAY on the same route. Measured with Claude Code 2.1.310 on the ChatGPT account and OpenAI key routes (test_gateway_v8_traffic CommentaryReplayTests): Codex commentary reaches the client as thinking carrying the gateway-internal marker cpa:commentary:v1, and the next Codex turn receives it back as an assistant phase commentary message; the marker reaches no upstream. On a model switch to a Claude-format route the client itself drops that thinking block, so the commentary text is not carried across families; a replayed marked block becomes plain assistant text (and an empty one is dropped), while a genuine Claude signature stays a signed thinking block (CommentaryMarkerControlTests). The marker is forgeable by design and buys plain text only.

fixes.subject: fix(openai): isolate duplex turn reauthorization from gin context and enforce bound principal; fix(codex): bind duplex websocket turns to requested client model after interceptor rewrites
fixes.reason: The duplex fixes (#6949, #6952) need codex response steering, which is not rendered, or interceptors (plugins off). The ordinary Responses WebSocket path they share re-authenticates each turn against the current keys: a key retired by rotation is refused with 401 on the socket it opened, with no upstream request, after the overlap turn succeeded (ResponsesWebsocketKeyRetirementTests). 6340fe43 touches codex_websockets_duplex.go, a file in patch 28's log inventory; its log sites are unchanged.

fixes.subject: fix(plugin): preserve caller scope for replayed Claude OAuth MCP tool aliases
fixes.reason: Reachable on the Claude OAuth route: the server component of the MCP name a non-MCP client tool is sent under now derives from session.CallerScope (a hash of the gateway key) instead of the key itself; the plugin replay half is off. Measured (CallerScopedAliasTests): the alias is stable for one key, differs between two keys, never contains a key, and the reply restores the client's tool name. Tool names in a cached prompt prefix change once with the re-pin.

fixes.subject: feat(management): support session-scoped OAuth proxy with per-account persistence (#6973)
fixes.reason: Adds POST /v8/management/oauth/auth-url. Patch 4's engine-level guard already refused it; the route is now in the reviewed route table as refused (TestManagementAllowlist_RouteTableMatchesReview fails on an unreviewed route). The per-account OAuth proxy persistence needs management writes and plugins, both off.

fixes.subject: fix(api): explicitly allow Authorization in CORS preflight responses
fixes.reason: Reachable on the inference routes' CORS preflight (origins and credentials policy unchanged; a browser page still needs the local key). Patch 4 refuses management before CORS: TestManagementAllowlist_PreflightRefusedBeforeCORS sends management preflights through the handler and the engine and gets the bare 404 with no CORS header; it fails when the guard runs after CORS.

fixes.subject: fix(claude): handle forced tool restrictions in claude 5.5
fixes.reason: Reachable on the Claude OAuth and Claude key routes for Opus and Sonnet 5.5: a forced tool_choice (any or a named tool) becomes auto before thinking preparation, in requests and count_tokens, instead of the provider refusing it; payload rules still apply afterwards. The Antigravity half is not rendered. No credential or route-availability change.

fixes.subject: fix(auth,pluginapi,usage): share per-selection ID between Scheduler.Pick and UsageRecord
fixes.reason: Inert as rendered: a selection ID is generated only in pickViaPluginScheduler (plugins off) and the legacy picker clears it; usage statistics are off. The plugin rejection's request-stop error and the unwrapExecutionBoundaryError changes keep the selection errors charmer's routes return.

fixes.subject: discovery: draft TXT schema, advertise-management deprecated, bounded mDNS caches, documentation
fixes.reason: LAN discovery is off: the schema pins discovery.enabled false, the render states it, and the advertiser only starts when it is enabled (sdk/cliproxy/discovery_advertiser.go). DiscoveryOffTests: no discovery log line and no UDP socket in the gateway's namespace, against an enabled control that logs the advertiser. 11e5f67b makes github.com/miekg/dns v1.1.43 a direct requirement (no version change); the module patch keeps it and every charmer pin.

fixes.subject: fix(watcher): preserve file snapshot binding on persisted auth updates
fixes.reason: Shared watcher code; #6951's disable race needs management writes, refused. Patches 5, 6 and 32 moved by line offsets only and their watcher, initial-auth and terminal-rejection gates are green.

fixes.subject: stream error and cancellation reporting (#6981, #6979, #6987)
fixes.reason: Reachable shared stream paths: a buffered Responses WebSocket error is drained before a closed data channel is reported, and a closed channel with a canceled context (also before the first chunk) reports cancellation instead of EOF. The HTTP delivery outcome the managed client sees is unchanged (#6987 concerns internal ExecuteModelStream accounting).

fixes.subject: translator fixes: finishReason in Codex/OpenAI to Gemini streams; Claude thinking tokens as OpenAI reasoning tokens
fixes.reason: Reachable only for admitted local clients of the Gemini and Chat formats, not the managed client's Messages format; response correctness, no credential or route change.

fixes.subject: fix(gemini): keep truncated HTTP 200 streams out of credential cooldown and failover
fixes.reason: The fixed native Gemini and Vertex executors serve no rendered route; the new skip-cooldown error flag is inert under disable-cooling true, and OpenAI-compatible and Codex errors do not set it. openai_compat_executor.go moved patch 10 by line offsets only.

fixes.subject: lint, native Gemini/Vertex/AI Studio/xAI/Antigravity/Interactions/Devin translators, Home retries, plugin schema 7, README
fixes.reason: No effect in the rendered configuration: the native Gemini, Vertex, AI Studio, xAI, Antigravity and Devin routes are not rendered, Interactions is refused, Home and plugins are off, and the rest is lint or documentation. The registry snapshot charmer reads (models.json, codex_client_models.json) is byte-identical to 8.0.42's; only devin_models.json changed.

fixes.subject: test(executor): fix race conditions in flaky websocket executor tests
fixes.reason: Test-only: fixes the retry-bind and xAI keepalive fixtures, not TestCodexWebsockets_KeepalivePingDuringUpload_Sessionless (see test_exclusions).

test_exclusions.reason: An ordering race in the upstream fixture, not a product path: the fake server writes response.completed right after its pong check and returns, closing the socket, without waiting to read the client request whose write the test holds in a hook; when the hook releases, the write can hit the closed socket and ExecuteStream fails with use of closed network connection (codex_websockets_executor_test.go:2822). Real upstreams read the request before answering. Excluded by name from the executor gate, which runs the other 1880 of the package's 1881 tests.
test_exclusions.measured: 2026-10-27, 1000 runs each: 4 failures on pristine v8.0.44 and 82 on the 27-patch tree, every one with that signature; the patched tree runs the same write and only shifts the scheduling.
test_exclusions.upstream: PR #6754 (open, unmerged) makes the keepalive fixtures wait for the held request; 84e83441 fixed the xAI and retry-bind cases only. charmer does not file it upstream; it stays a recorded exclusion.
test_exclusions.re_check: At every re-pin: rerun the test on the pristine tag and remove the skip once upstream's fixture waits for the request.
